title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Pin a chat**: You can now pin a chat to keep it at the top of the sidebar. See [Manage chats in the sidebar](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#manage-chats).
* **MCP writes in the mobile app (Beta)**: The Genie One mobile app now supports MCP write actions from connected tools. See [Connect to external tools and sources](/aws/en/genie-one/external-sources).

ref_links.text: Connect to external tools and sources
